notes: Per-eye route for the frame generation / Native Stereo Fix A/B (plans\hogwarts-fg-nsf.ps1, analysis\eyesampler.py). Not run yet: the screens, clicks and quit path are Hogwarts.json's (title > the ARAM HAN card, its newest save > Esc > 설정 > 게임 종료 > Space), only the play part is new. Instead of random walking it turns the camera at a steady rate (pan_s: 200 mickeys per 0.5 s, 0.05 s between the moves, so both eyes change on every new frame; a play step's "every" comes after its "hold"), then walks with small turns (walk_s), then opens and closes the field guide twice (Native Stereo Fix state changes): each toggle is a measured "field-guide" segment from just before the Esc press to 3 s after it, without screen captures (the pilot's 4K captures stall the eye sampler, and the state change comes within frames of the press); the screen is checked after the segment, then a few seconds of panning. The game saves when it quits, so each run starts where the previous one quit (walk_s of walking apart; a fixed spot needs the save ladder route, Hogwarts-save). Under monado-service MOPIC_MODE=sbs the harness reads the screens from the left eye (-MopicSbs / -EyeSampler: gamepilot --source mopic-sbs); the checkpoints were recorded on the woven display, so check them once on a live side-by-side title screen first: gamepilot.py HogwartsLegacy checkpoint test recipes\Hogwarts-eyes.json all --source mopic-sbs.
